name: parallel-work-backlog
title: sd-work-backlog --workers N: parallel backlog workers
description: Owner-requested 2026-08-08: run N concurrent sd-work-backlog workers with the count user-specified, each in an isolated git worktree with conflict-safe atomic task claiming so no two workers ever claim the same task, merges to the default branch serialized through the existing housekeeping gate, and per-worker ledger state so one crashed worker never strands the rest; prerequisites are the work-loop ledger fix, provenance session collision, developer identity in worktrees, collision-proof session numbering, and worktree inventory in status.
creator: sdelmas
